full_text: Local treasurers, accountants and other local accountable officers shall render their accounts within such time, in such form, style, and content and under such as the Commission on Audit may prescribe. Provincial, city, and municipal auditors shall certify the balances arising in the accounts settled by them to the Chairman of the Commission on Audit and to the local treasurer, accountant, and other accountable officers. Copies of the certification shall be prepared and furnished other local officers who may be held jointly and severally liable for any loss or illegal, improper or unauthorized use or misappropriation of local funds or property.
